target.title: fix(codex): do not promote missing_tool_result on abort/interrupt
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Codex app-server turns that end mid-exec (user abort, steer/interrupt, or other interrupt terminals) while a native `commandExecution` is still open would fail the whole attempt with a synthesized `missing_tool_result` prompt error. Operators then saw a generic tool-invariant failure instead of abort/interrupt classification, and any partial assistant text could be treated as a failed run.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep the fail-closed synthetic `tool.result` rows for transcript/trajectory integrity, but stop promoting that invariant to the attempt `promptError` when the authoritative outcome is already `aborted` or turn status `interrupted`. Ordinary completed turns that still lack a matching tool result continue to record `promptError` as before. Failed-turn real errors remain preferred via the existing `this.promptError` assignment on `turn.status === "failed"`.

## User Impact

When a Codex-backed turn is cancelled or interrupted while a long-running native tool is still open, the attempt keeps abort/interrupt semantics instead of dying as a generic missing-tool invariant error. Partial assistant text on interrupted turns is preserved as non-error assistant output. Transcripts still show a synthetic failed tool result for the unfinished call.

## Evidence

Verification host: local macOS

### Current-main refresh

Merged latest `origin/main` into this branch (no force-push) so the projector guard and tests sit on current main after recent projector-adjacent refactors.

### Focused unit / projector regression (post-merge)

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts -t "does not promote missing_tool_result|records promptError when a completed turn has only whitespace"
# → 3 passed (abort mid-exec, interrupted pending tool, completed orphan control)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts
# → 148 passed
```

Focused proof excerpt:

```text
✓ does not promote missing_tool_result to promptError when aborted mid-exec
✓ does not promote missing_tool_result to promptError for interrupted turns with pending tools
✓ records promptError when a completed turn has only whitespace assistant text and an orphan tool call
```

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: Live Codex app-server mid-exec interrupt must not promote synthetic `missing_tool_result` to run-level `promptError`, while still retaining the synthetic missing-tool detail for transcript integrity.
- Environment: local macOS; user `CODEX_HOME` (~/.codex) with existing Codex subscription auth; OpenClaw `createIsolatedCodexAppServerClient` (`homeScope=user`) + `CodexAppServerEventProjector` from this branch after main merge.
- Current-main contrast: Without the guard, `buildResult` would set `promptError` from the synthesized missing-tool string whenever an open `commandExecution` lacks a matching tool result on abort/interrupt.
- Exact steps after this patch:
  1. Start real Codex app-server client with user homeScope.
  2. `thread/start` + `turn/start` prompting a long native command: `/bin/bash -lc 'sleep 600'`.
  3. Observe live `item/started` `commandExecution` `inProgress` for that command.
  4. `turn/interrupt` while the command is still open.
  5. Observe `turn/completed` with `status=interrupted`.
  6. Call `projector.buildResult(...)` on the live notification stream.
- Evidence after fix (redacted):

```text
steps:
  - start isolated codex app-server client (homeScope=user)
  - thread/start ok
  - turn/start ok status=inProgress
  - pre-interrupt sawCommand=true notifications=27
  - turn/interrupt ok
finalTurnStatus: interrupted
sawCommand: true
commandExecution:
  itemId: exec-54302a01-300b-4077-ab1f-5a21407b94dc
  status: inProgress
  command: /bin/zsh -c "/bin/bash -lc 'sleep 600'"
turn/completed: interrupted
projectorResult:
  aborted: false
  promptError: null
  promptErrorSource: null
  lastToolError.toolName: bash
  lastToolError.error: OpenClaw recorded a native Codex tool.call without a matching tool.result before the turn completed. toolCallId=exec-54302a01-...; toolName=bash
assertions:
  noMissingToolPromptErrorPromotion: true
  retainedSyntheticMissingToolDetail: true
  liveInterruptedOrAborted: true
  pass: true
```

- Control check: Focused unit control still expects completed orphan-tool turns to promote `promptError` containing `without a matching tool.result` (fail-closed path unchanged).
- Observed result after fix: Live interrupted mid-exec turn keeps `promptError === null` and retains synthetic missing-tool detail via `lastToolError`; unit suite 148/148 green on post-main merge tree.
- What was not tested: Full OpenClaw gateway multi-turn harness UI abort button path; TUI client-shutdown policy tracked separately (#98762).

Fixes #104898

## AI disclosure

This fix was implemented with AI assistance (Grok contributor agent). Human/operator review of the PR is still expected before merge.
